Question: What is the loss ratio, number of claims, total loss by policy number and premium where total loss is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount and loss ratio is total loss divided by premium?
Generated Query:
WITH claim_totals AS (
    SELECT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS claim_total_loss
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
        ON ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
        ON er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
       OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier
),
policy_claims AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Number,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ct.Claim_Identifier) AS number_of_claims,
        SUM(ct.claim_total_loss) AS total_loss
    FROM claim_totals ct
    JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        ON pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = ct.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
       AND pcd.Effective_Date = ct.Effective_Date
    JOIN Policy p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        p.Policy_Number
),
policy_premium AS (
    SELECT
        p.Policy_Number,
        SUM(COALESCE(pa.Policy_Amount, 0)) AS premium
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN Policy p
        ON p.Policy_Identifier = pa.Policy_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        p.Policy_Number
)
SELECT
    pc.Policy_Number,
    pp.premium,
    pc.number_of_claims,
    pc.total_loss,
    CASE
        WHEN pp.premium IS NULL OR pp.premium = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE pc.total_loss / pp.premium
    END AS loss_ratio
FROM policy_claims pc
LEFT JOIN policy_premium pp
    ON pp.Policy_Number = pc.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
    pc.Policy_Number;

FROM Premium p

    ON pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier = p.Policy_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Policy pol

JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr

    c.Company_Claim_Number,
    SUM(COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Loss_Payment lp
    WHERE lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Loss_Reserve lr
    WHERE lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)
OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Expense_Payment ep
    WHERE ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)
OR EXISTS (

    FROM Expense_Reserve er
    WHERE er.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
)
